newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen rangebound in cautious trade.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen rangebound in cautious trade.

text.p: Thai stocks were seen moving in a narrow range on Friday as persistent selling pressure was seen keeping prices on the market from moving up, brokers said.
"The SET index is expected to move around yesterday's close. There will be selling interest if shares post some gains," said one broker at Ekachart Finance and Securities.
Brokers said investors were concerned about the financial health of most cash-strapped finance firms which have struggled to cope with a prolonged market slump and a sluggish economy.
The SET index finished 4.82 points off at new eight-year lows of 548.05 on thin 2.8 billion baht trade.
